immigration.text: Rogers campaigns on closing the border and has a record of restricting immigration.
immigration.quote: We must close our borders, protect the unborn, unleash American energy, and grow our economy!

tax.text: McInnis says the wealthy should pay more and backs raising taxes on high earners to fund services for working families.
tax.quote: Supports raising wages for working families and increasing taxes on high-income earners.

schools.text: McInnis advocates for quality, free public education for every child.
schools.quote: Supports quality, free public education for every child.

health.text: McInnis says the district has healthcare deserts and calls for healthcare for all.
health.quote: In the richest country in the world, it doesn't have to be this way. We can have healthcare for all.
